segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Davis. What brings you into the clinic today?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Hi Doctor, I've had a severe sore throat and a low-grade fever for the past three days. It's getting harder to swallow.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: I see. Have you had any cough, difficulty breathing, or rash?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No cough or shortness of breath, just mild body aches and fatigue.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Understood. Before we consider any antibiotics, do you have any drug allergies?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, I am allergic to Amoxicillin and Penicillin. I got hives the last time I took it.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Noted, we will avoid the penicillin family. Let's do an examination of your throat.
